items.title: Runtime governance for AI agents with Noma Security and AgentCore Gateway
items.summary: An AI agent can be authorized to use a tool and still use it for the wrong task. Noma Security's AI Detection and Response (AI-DR) complements AWS controls with semantic evaluation of content and intent at Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. By connecting proposed actions with the user's request, it helps catch intent mismatches such as a payment change during a summary task. Security teams gain configurable enforcement and a shared session history for supported traffic routed through the gateway.
items.creator: Amir Hazoom
